summary: Require protected handling of mass deletion and large structural changes, with verified pre-change recovery points and the newest ten recovery points retained for controlled restoration.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform Super Administrator explicitly approved building the critical-change protection rule, specifically requested recovery to approximately the latest ten change points even after a change completes, and then directed implementation to continue.
implementation: classify mass site deletion and platform-wide structural changes as critical changes
block direct production mutation for critical scope
require a verified pre-change restore point, isolated validation, staging verification and super-administrator approval
retain the newest ten verified recovery-point records in the recovery control plane
make restoration itself a critical change with a pre-restore recovery point and post-restore verification
require separate approval for permanent purge or irreversible deletion
bind recovery metadata to source commit/release references and affected D1 recovery coordinates
mandatoryRules: critical destructive or platform-wide structural requests never directly mutate production
a verified restore point is mandatory before critical production mutation
the recovery control plane exposes the newest ten verified recovery points
restore execution requires super-administrator approval and must preserve an undo path where the platform supports one
permanent deletion requires a distinct approval from ordinary change approval
AI workers may not bypass branch isolation, CI, staging or guarded release
rollback: Revert the critical-change control module, governor additions and deployment-policy amendment through the guarded release path; preserve existing recovery records and do not perform destructive cleanup as part of rollback.
